scope: Integrated English dark WPF trainer. New features are validated statically and in isolated fixtures; live game and visual validation remain pending.

domains.rescue: Slots 176..183: one-time saved rescue-use counter plus seven diagnostics. Separate appearance statistic, native mission and partner gates are preserved.
domains.missions: Slots 208..229: native countdown/count-up restart and mission diagnostics. Native timeout events still apply; counters and gauges are observations only.
domains.cameraextra: Slots 240..248: held-camera roll, recenter and snap at the existing follow-task boundary, and ownership/distance diagnostics.
domains.world_camera: FOV and held pose require normal owner/submode and bind the scheduler, scene heap and complete ten-byte map target. Native ownership change ends both overrides.
domains.drive: Reviewed forced Drive behavior remains included: all six exact forms, independent of gauge, party requirements, unlock and random form selection; existing form reverts before the selected form starts.

dispatch.note: Common router rebuilds context after commands and after DriveTick. CameraExtra reset is called by disable-all, host expiry and best-effort engine-thread failure cleanup. Mission and Rescue carry no persistent overrides.

validation.result_location: The completed release's Validation logs, Manifest.json, PackageCheck.json and work/trainer/release-v06-validation.json are authoritative for the packaged build and final counts.

limits: No live game process or computer-use testing was performed in this continuation.
The bridge remains pinned until game exit; close and restart KH2 before connecting an updated trainer.
The original game executable, existing mods and save files are unchanged by this build process.
Semantic analysis of the executable remains incomplete; exported function inventories do not establish full behavior knowledge.
